problem: Which migration approach fits the legacy monolith API?
goals: Deliver incrementally without a big-bang cutover
sourceText: legacy API serves 200 clients; no feature flags; weekly release cadence

workerA.summary: Rewrite the API in one release.

claims.statement: A single rewrite minimizes coordination overhead.
The team can freeze clients for the cutover.

workerB.summary: Strangler-fig migration behind a feature flag with shadow traffic.

claims.statement: A strangler pattern lets clients migrate incrementally.
Feature flags plus shadow traffic give rollback safety without downtime.

decisionConditions: If shadow traffic exceeds 2x cost, gate rollout

workerAShared.summary: I agree with B; let us ship the strangler.

reviewer.rationale: B satisfies the no-downtime constraint; A cannot.
